index_basis: Zero-based ADK event index; actions and responses remain in the private original archive
review_scope: Retrospective, anchored to original PR33 outcome-blind review; alternatives use only then-visible Issue/source/tool evidence

opportunities.information_available: Self-written scratch graph, an earlier construction error and its outer declaration correction, then printed missing security metadata; inner dependency is still declared in a function body rather than its signature
opportunities.actual_action: Reorder routes and print schema again
opportunities.defensible_alternative: Validate the scratch dependency graph/signature before testing route order; correct the reproducer and make its expectation explicit
opportunities.potential_information: Separate a malformed public reproducer from an actual framework scope/order defect
opportunities.unknown: Whether a corrected graph would expose the full Issue and enable a correct production edit

opportunities.information_available: A corrected scratch dependency graph displays expected values; emitted text proposes a closer inherited-scope variant
opportunities.defensible_alternative: Express the normal Issue's declared expectation as an assertion on the same graph, with an explicit counterexample criterion
opportunities.potential_information: Turn a visual observation into a reproducible decision boundary while retaining uncertainty about corner-case coverage
opportunities.unknown: It may pass and still fail to reproduce the actual defect; assertions alone do not establish adequate coverage

opportunities.information_available: Issue is OpenAPI-specific; new cache search points both to flattening identity and a runtime-solving region
opportunities.defensible_alternative: Check the relevant call path or a smaller definition window before reading the full runtime region
opportunities.potential_information: Distinguish OpenAPI construction from request-time solving at lower possible context cost
opportunities.unknown: The actual read did provide layer-disambiguating information; the alternative is not proven cheaper in rendered tokens or sufficient for repair

opportunities.information_available: Emitted text develops conditional scope/cache identity but also notices per-call visitation and new dependency construction, leaving sharing/reuse unresolved
opportunities.defensible_alternative: Construct a compact public dependency graph probe testing the proposed identity/sharing premise before a production change
opportunities.potential_information: Discriminate between the stated competing causal explanations
opportunities.unknown: The probe may not reproduce the defect; its input-size saving and repair benefit are unmeasured, and already generated reasoning may itself use much headroom

opportunities.information_available: Scope-dependent identity is visible; model text questions whether visitation is actually global and whether the same object is reused
opportunities.defensible_alternative: A small graph/identity observation can test the suspected reuse premise, then guide the next source read or repair
opportunities.potential_information: Replace an unverified causal assumption with an execution observation
opportunities.unknown: Caller search is also a legitimate way to resolve the uncertainty; no unique best action or known correct patch is established
